method: Inclusion is every species printed under the Emballonuridae heading on the 2011 Wayback SANParks KNP mammal checklist PDF (1 species). English and Afrikaans names, and species order, are taken from that PDF. Scientific names are the 2011 names unless an iNaturalist taxon record cited in remaps gives a current name. Research-grade counts are for iNaturalist place_id 69020. iNaturalist-only emballonuridae are in candidates, not species. The PDF was fetched to a temporary path for text extraction and was not copied into this project.

sources.role: Official inclusion list; English and Afrikaans species names; species order; absence of asterisk status flags on Emballonuridae
Research-grade species counts for Emballonuridae in Kruger (place 69020); 1 species in this pull (Taphozous mauritianus, 64)
All-grade Emballonuridae taxonomy tree for place 69020; used to confirm the Kruger taxon is Taphozous mauritianus (66 observations of any grade)
Current name list for Taphozous mauritianus (taxon 41380); used with taxa?id=41380&all_names=true

remaps.note: iNaturalist preferred_common_name for taxon 41380. The stored en value is the 2011 SANParks checklist name.

gaps: Live SANParks checklist HTML and PDF were not fetched in this session (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403). Inclusion is the 2011 Wayback PDF only, and has not been compared with the live 147–148 figure.
iNaturalist checklist 8810 was not fetched (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403/401).

No rare, reintroduced, or introduced flags are recorded for official Emballonuridae species: the 2011 PDF does not mark any of them with an asterisk or other status note (asterisks on that list are only for house mouse and house/black rat under Muridae).
The current live official list, Skinner & Chimimba, and Stuart's guide were not available to corroborate remaps or flags.
